_comment: Fallback conversation used by any character without a dialogue file of their own - including ones made with the character creator. It leans on script functions so it reacts to whatever the NPC is doing and wants.

first.text: {name()}, {title()}. You will be the auditor everybody is whispering about.

variants.text: Not a good day. Not a good week, if I am honest. What is it?
Is it me, or is the air getting thick? ...What did you want?
Lights keep dipping. You get used to it. You should not have to. Yes?
Good to see you. What do you need?
Something I can do for you?

choices.text: Let me see what you are selling.
How is the station holding up?
I will let you get on.

variants.text: Since you ask: I am short {wants_count()} x {item_name(wants())} and I cannot find any on the whole station.
A meal. The dispenser has been empty every time I look.
Eight hours of sleep and a week off. Failing that, nothing you can carry.
Kind of you. No, I am all right.

choices.text: I will keep an eye out.

thanks.text: That is exactly what I needed. Thank you - I will remember it.

station.text: Reactor at {round(cond('reactor'))} percent, {round(res('water'))} litres in the tanks, air at {round(res('air'))}. {'We have seen worse.' if cond('reactor') >= 60 else 'I have stopped looking at the boards.'}
